description: SQL query concatenated with untrusted request parameter (SQL injection).
snippet:
query = "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE cust_id='" + request.args.get("id") + "'"
cursor.execute(query)
contexts: OWASP A05:2025 Injection. Use a parameterized API so user input cannot change query structure.
OWASP A07:2025 Authentication Failures. CWE-798 Use of Hard-coded Credentials.

description: Untrusted pickle.loads can execute arbitrary code (CWE-502).
contexts: OWASP A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures. Insecure deserialization (CWE-502).

description: HTTP request to user-controlled URL (SSRF / CWE-918).
contexts: OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control includes SSRF (CWE-918). Allow-list destinations.

description: OS command built from unsanitized input (command injection).
contexts: OWASP A05 Injection. Do not concatenate untrusted data into OS commands.
CVE-2020-8203 Prototype Pollution in lodash prior to 4.17.19. Upgrade the dependency.
CVE-2021-44228 Log4Shell: attacker-controlled LDAP JNDI lookups enable remote code execution.

description: yaml.load without a SafeLoader can deserialize untrusted objects.
contexts: Prefer yaml.safe_load. Untrusted deserialization maps to integrity / injection failures.
